# verb: # Spanish pronominal verbs (C13; teacher-editable): verb lemma + particle "se" -> one Latin verb lemma + frame. The
# frame builder writes particle "se" when a clitic of the verb's own person stands with it ("me equivoco", "vete",
# "siéntate", "inclínense", "se escapó"). Same columns and frames as phrasal_en_la.tsv: empty (the Latin verb as it
# is), refl (adds the reflexive object: "¡Todos, inclínense!" -> Omnēs, inclīnāte vōs!), intr, acc / dat / abl.
# Particle "-" = the bare verb with a fixed Latin frame. Without a row the reflexive clitic is the object (sē).

note: Me encanta el jardín. -> Hortus mihi placet.
